Closer Look: Farm

Closer Look: Farm is a calm interactive diorama set on a farm. Characters come to life with a tap, then settle again.

Closer Look

Closer Look is a series of calm interactive dioramas, each inviting you to explore a small world at your own pace. Settings can vary from one release to another.

In-app purchases are planned. Pricing and included content will be explained before release.

No ads. Ever.
